notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Release
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.0.2[/h1]
[list]
[*]More options to move between clues, mouse wheel, left and right arrows and forward and back buttons will now move between clues
[*]Input detection moved to happen on each update, rather than each frame to hopefully fix missed inputs
[*]Shep the helper dog can now be turned off after activating him. (You monsters, he's just doing his job!)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1
[b]Requested feature added[/b]
[list]
[*]Animation frequency can now be changed. You can turn it off altogether but that will make the dogs sad. (Press "A" on your keyboard to make them move if you need to)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0 Release
notes.content:
And we are live! It has felt like forever since we started on our little journey to create a logic problem game with dogs and some silly jokes, but we are very happy to be here on launch day with our day 1, version 1.0. This patch includes a few language fixes that were picked up and some tweaks to how the clicks are being registered in an attempt to fix an issue some people have experienced. 

The dogs are very excited to meet you all and if you have any issues, please feel free to post in the discussion board are send us an email so we can address it ASAP.

If you are passionate about your dog and would like to see them represented in a future hidden puzzle, please also drop us an email at admin@terrierblegames.com with a picture of your dog and your steam name.

notes.title: Trailer released and Launch date announced
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44104890/8b1dc9b4303e8eb5922e5d545e7ab7f20f9b9f97.png"][/img]Greetings to all lovers of Logic and dogs. We have exciting news! First of all, we've released the official trailer for the game on to the store front, so please check it out. It's a bit silly, but we think it captures the spirit of the game and we hope you enjoy it.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="SJgHVT4kiys;full"][/previewyoutube][p]And then our other big news is that we are now ready to release the game! It's been 8 years since we first started putting together ideas for this and it feel good to finally have the game in a place where we believe it can be enjoyed fully. We've given it to a few people for testing and have given ourselves a bit of time to address any last minute issues, and the game will be launching on the 15th July 2025. [/p][p]We can't wait for you to play this![/p][p][/p]
